diagnosis.mechanism: The test fixture retained the spelling returned by TemporaryDirectory (/var/... on the macOS runner). CHECKER.check rejects a linked repository root leaf and then resolves its accepted root before reading descendants. Descendant lstat/os.open therefore use /private/var/... . Equality-based mock targets retained /var/... and missed three descendant reparse injections and the changed-open injection. The root reparse case still matched because the root lstat precedes resolution.
diagnosis.confidence: Exact four failures reproduced on Linux with a symlinked TMPDIR; same module passes through a regular TMPDIR before repair.

repair.comment: Canonicalize the already-created private temporary directory so fault-injection targets match the checker's admitted canonical root, including macOS /var -> /private/var.

local_reproduction.environment: Private temporary workspace with ordinary directory and alias symlink -> real directory. For each, launch the existing focused test module with TMPDIR, TEMP and TMP set to that path and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.
